english:
Breaking a Combatant's Shield grants 20 Stability, 20 Handling, and 20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.

Swords also receive 20 Guard Resistance.

source.text:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Shield:

+20 Stability, +20 Handling, and +20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
Swords receive +20 Guard Resistance.
